originalValueMap.old: Five Responses item kinds/order; thinking summary one item and saying payload unchanged.
originalValueMap.now: Exact type array, exact one-item summary_text structure with supplied thinking body, user/assistant role and original body checks.
originalValueMap.why: These are native protocol discriminants and opaque history data, not judgments of the supplied sentence meaning.

originalValueMap.old: A persisted call without result fails loudly and reports affected call.
originalValueMap.now: Shared observer requires Error rejection and deep input preservation for unresolved-call/orphaned-result/mismatched-result; actual full diagnostic subjectively read for affected ID and accurate meaning.
originalValueMap.why: Removed old stale error wording is not lost business value; neither Error alone nor a prior verdict accepts future diagnostic meaning.

originalValueMap.old: Original normal fixture had call/result but did not fully assert their argument/output data or user payload.
originalValueMap.now: Exact call_id/name/raw arguments/output + user body; malformed raw argument and two parallel reversed results verify arrays of IDs/names/arguments/outputs in normalized call order, count included.
originalValueMap.why: Arrays retain count/order/association rather than Set membership; opaque Unicode/newline/quotes protect unmodified transport.

candidates.assertionLimit: Normal and invalid inputs checked immutable; do not claim every newly constructed malformed/parallel input has an explicit nonmutation assertion. No network/provider request, actual tool execution or durable history repair.

originalValueMap.old: Three-turn user/assistant/user alternation; tool history encoded as text, not native tool_use/tool_result.
originalValueMap.now: Both sync/async normal+malformed exact role arrays and all-text blocks; positive supplied content checks rule out vacuous empty every().
originalValueMap.why: Role/block enums are actual protocol shape; text wrappers have separate18-case subjective review scope.

originalValueMap.old: Raw tool JSON arguments remain in assistant text; malformed arguments and supplied error result stay visible.
originalValueMap.now: Entire supplied thinking/saying/raw malformed argument and result strings must be contained in their proper turns; full emitted wrappers independently read.
originalValueMap.why: Old Invalid-arguments prefix was given-input data, not generated error meaning; replacing it with full distinct opaque result preserves and strengthens fidelity. It never established actual tool-handler error behavior.

originalValueMap.old: Orphaned call fails without a result.
originalValueMap.now: Sync/async each reject all three invalid pairs, retain input unchanged and emit full actual diagnostic for subjective acceptance.
originalValueMap.why: No fixed explanation or callId= formatting accepted as semantic oracle.

originalValueMap.old: Original did not prove multi-call result identity/order.
originalValueMap.now: Two calls/results in reverse arrival are projected to five alternating turns; full given payloads in corresponding positions and input preservation asserted, exact generated IDs/tool names judged from full actual text.
originalValueMap.why: Containment only checks entire supplied payload presence; it does not automatically judge generated labels, uniqueness or interpretation.

candidates.assertionLimit: Given malformed result is opaque supplied history, no actual handler failure. Text containment does not freeze generated wrappers or by itself prove absence of extra/duplicate prose; actual wrapper meaning/current attribution was subjectively read. Normalization order is not observed real completion order.

originalValueMap.old: Four role order, standalone saying, thinking reasoning_content on visible assistant and tool call; tool-call content omitted.
originalValueMap.now: Exact native roles/body/reasoning/hasOwn(content)=false and full tool_calls/result association.
originalValueMap.why: Known input body transport and protocol presence/absence are concrete machine/data contracts.

originalValueMap.old: disable-assistant-tool-call-reasoning-content removes only call reasoning and keeps visible reasoning.
originalValueMap.now: Disabled call reasoning undefined while full call data equals normal; visible reasoning and body equal original.
originalValueMap.why: Positive retained payload prevents a vacuous all-assistant-data deletion.

originalValueMap.old: Generic reasoning and MiniMax details paths; original only checked one detail.text and used same text in content/details.
originalValueMap.now: Generic keeps explicit thinking body; MiniMax preserves full distinct details array and visible saying.
originalValueMap.why: Original equal texts did not distinguish source selection; new distinct sentinels clarify the tested paths without claiming a product behavior change or real provider reasoning correctness.

originalValueMap.old: Current fresh turn reasoning retained on a call after saying.
originalValueMap.now: Normal and parallel call-bearing messages equal that supplied current thinking body.
originalValueMap.why: Original separate genseq11 fixture was another independent fresh turn, not a cross-generation stale-reasoning negative; its value is retained without claiming broader stale-turn coverage.

originalValueMap.old: Orphan call rejects and native call ID/type/name exist; arguments only string typed.
originalValueMap.now: Three invalid pair cases with input preservation/full diagnostic review; malformed raw argument stays exact, full normal/parallel tuples preserve IDs/name/arguments/result and count/order.
originalValueMap.why: Native function/custom union is narrowed using actual type===function, no type weakening, casted fake input or literal error-meaning oracle.

candidates.assertionLimit: Normal and invalid inputs checked unchanged; no claim that all alternate quirk/malformed/parallel inputs are independently mutation-checked. No MiniMax SDK/network or reasoning-content correctness claim.

helper.value: A direct fixture for actually used three projections and observer for three bad-pair shapes. It supplies distinct opaque user/thinking/saying/JSON/result data with Unicode/newlines/quotes; cannot execute those instructions. Each rejection uses a clone taken before projection, requires real Error rejection and exact unchanged supplied history, then retains actual diagnostic pending independent meaning review. Positive legal cases prevent treating universal failure as success.
helper.limits: No new product/provider abstraction, framework or semantic detector. Error rejection alone proves refusal, not the reason/identity meaning; full actual evidence supplies that separate acceptance.

assertionReview.deletedAndRetainedChecks: Original supplied thinking/saying equality and raw argument containment are legitimate fidelity checks and remain; generated invariant-error fixed sentence/includes checks removed. Handwritten loose SDK-shape readers replaced actual discriminated unions/native type checks. Console PASS labels are reporting, not acceptance predicates.
assertionReview.entryAndLedger: Root/tests package add behavior+semantic projection lane and three isolated aliases; run.mjs registers exactly three candidates/three producers. Helper remains support, never a passing case. AGENTS/README/strategy/ledger distinguish generation pending from subjective acceptance and exclude SDK/live/tool/persistence/vision; other four image/truncation candidates remain unaudited by this batch.
assertionReview.productScope: No main/packages production diff in this batch. Real public wrappers call real common pair normalization/validation; no same-source formatter used to compute expected prose. Source inspection only verifies scope and actual machine path, not natural-language meaning.
